lang.snippet: The 20-item Toronto Alexithymia Scale (Bagby, Parker, & Taylor, 1994) was translated into Farsi and back-translated by a research team with one psychologist and two Ph.D. students of the English language, all of whom are fluent in both English and Farsi.

n.snippet: This study investigated the psychometric properties of the Farsi version of the 20-item Toronto Alexithymia Scale for 587 undergraduate students (349 women and 238 men) at the University of Tehran.

sex.snippet: Participants were 587 undergraduate students (349 women and 238 men) from the University of Tehran.

age.snippet: The mean age of the sample was 20.2 yr. (SD = 1.9; range = 18 to 27).

clinical.snippet: Participants were 587 undergraduate students (349 women and 238 men) from the University of Tehran. All students participated as volunteers.

res.snippet: Each item is rated on a 5-point Likert-type scale anchored by 1: Strongly disagree and 5: Strongly agree.

nfac.snippet: Using confirmatory factor analysis, the three-factor structure of the FTAS-20 was tested for the entire sample.

cfa.snippet: Using confirmatory factor analysis, the three-factor structure of the FTAS-20 was tested for the entire sample.
